text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes... I had an exciting dream last night.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
There was a spiral staircase that
extended into
the azure sky... and a
rippling golden sea
stretched out
below...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And I ran with my friend, as far as our
legs would
take us...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I hope I can see those sights again...
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Manhattan Cafe's exciting
dream has
left her feeling completely
refreshed!
